candidates.name: Operator-adapted opposing edge tests with exceptional discard sets, averaged over incidences
paper_items: I33 edge lower/upper bounds + incidence averaging (tests.tex:72-141)
candidates.trace: no reasoning trace exists for family 330
candidates.statement: Given a finite-rank T (norm <= 2p) with finite support S and measures mu_x, for each oriented incidence e:x->y build a 1-Lipschitz f_e: M_p -> [-L,L] equal to b_x on S\E_e and -b_y on S\E_{e-bar}; then int f_e d(mu_x - mu_y) >= 3L/2 - 2L(|mu_x|(E_e)+|mu_y|(E_{e-bar})) and <= 2p. Since each state is exceptional in at most one of Delta directions at a good vertex, E|mu_x|(E_e) <= V/Delta + V*beta < 1/10, giving 2p > 11p.
